title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Selling of property to someone else without full payment 2687 views Q. In a business there are 2 partners,One partner who invest money and the second partner finds business(work) only,they share profit as follows partner who invest 75% and partner who finds work 25%,if there is a loss in the work does the partner who only finds work has to bear the loss in above mentioned ratio or he is partner in profit only? Nothing was discussed to share in loss. 2045 views Q. My cousin is having a business. I like to invest in his business. He agrees to share returns every year based on profit and loss of the company but does not want to include me as a partner officially in the company. Therefore although for all practical purposes I will be a deemed partner in the company there will be no official record for the same. As per the governmant rules only partners are entitiles to share in the profit and loss of the company. To overcome this legal hurdle my cousin offers to give me my share of profit in the name of "interest" although actually it is my share of profit and not acutally riba. If there is loss in the company I would not receive any returns and will share in the the loss. Please advise whether this arrangement is OK and not contrary to the principles of Shariah. 1796 views Q. I have a question regarding business for one of my colleagues 1827 views Q. I am in Canada.I want to lease a gas/petrol pum from the oil company.According to the rule of this country you are bound to sale lottery tickets in gas station.Can i lease the station with the intention of not getting the income of lottery tickets. 2115 views Q. Stone Carving and Stone Angle 1687 views Q. Unfortunately i haven't any certificate by recognised institutes. My Question is that one can run allopathic dispensary like me without any certificate of any institutes recognised under the rule of Govt. of India , where it is prohibited in India. I run a transportation business i.e. I carry goods from one place to another in our trucks or rented trucks, can I transport goods containing cigarettes/pan masala as i have read that smoking cigarettes an eating pan masala is haraam in Islam. 1988 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Business Question ID: 48729 Country: India Title: water plant halal or haram Question: I am planning to start a business of water plant i.e. purifying and supplying of water is halal or haram in Islam or it is permissible in Islam. Answer ID: 48729 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1664/1214/H=11/1434) It is halal. You should maintain balance in the price, it is better. It is not better to take more price than usual. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
